---
schema_version: "1.0.0"
ticket_id: "OMN-14968"
title: "OCC evidence for OMN-14968 — dev-lane runtime-worker replicas fail-closed"
summary: >
  OCC companion for OmniNode-ai/omnibase_infra PR #2536. The base compose resolved runtime-worker deploy.replicas
  from a BARE ${WORKER_REPLICAS:-0} that no surface in the repo exports, so the dev lane (docker-compose.infra.yml
  with no overlay) always rendered zero replicas: `docker compose up -d --no-deps runtime-worker` exited
  0 creating nothing, while deploy-runtime.sh's RUNTIME_SERVICES feeds the RT-6 deploy-readback scope
  and requires a running container — so every dev-lane deploy aborted at the fail-closed readback and
  auto-restored. The line now resolves ${DEV_WORKER_REPLICAS:?...}, the lane-prefixed fail-closed form
  already used by the sibling DEV_RUNTIME_WORKER_* vars in the same service block and by the stability-test/prod
  overlays under OMN-12988 / OMN-12990. Evidence is executed compose renders on .201: dev replicas 0 ->
  1, an unset policy value now FAILS the render (exit 1) instead of silently rendering 0, and the stability-test
  / prod / judge renders are byte-identical pre vs post.
is_seam_ticket: false
interface_change: false
interfaces_touched: []
# REBOUND (OMN-15382, dod_verify 3/7 FAIL): five historical check_values were either (a) a human-readable
# "Recorded product receipt: ..." prose description handed verbatim to `sh -c` (the literal first word
# "Recorded" fails "command not found", exit 127) or (b) the OMN-14431 bare ${PR_NUMBER}/${REPO} runner
# placeholder in dod-OmniNode-ai-omnibase_infra-pr-2536, which never pinned PR #2536 -- it silently
# re-checked whatever PR the compliance runner happened to be evaluating. Append-only replacement entries
# below supersede those five immutable historical entries with hosted-runnable, falsifiable commands that
# bind the same evidence: a literal PR #2536 pin, gh-api content probes against omnibase_infra PR #2536's
# merge commit (11b460db23d40dd2ca7704d0c3e9fd89851af60c) for the two committed test names and the static
# ratchet assertion string, and an in-OCC-checkout grep against the already-committed lane-render-parity
# receipt's sha256 fragments (replacing the vacuous `docker compose ... | sha256sum` pipe, which exits 0
# on ANY input including empty stdin when docker/the compose files are unavailable in the hosted runner).
evidence_requirements:
  - kind: "ci"
    description: "PR #2536 CI checks green"
    command: "gh pr checks ${PR_NUMBER} --repo ${REPO}"
  - kind: "tests"
    description: >
      Dev lane renders runtime-worker with one replica (GREEN); the same render against the pre-fix compose
      yields replicas 0 (RED).
    command: >
      docker compose --env-file docker/runtime-policy.env -f docker/docker-compose.infra.yml --profile
      runtime config
  - kind: "tests"
    description: >
      Fail-closed: with DEV_WORKER_REPLICAS absent from the policy env the render exits non-zero naming
      the variable, never falling back to a replica count.
    command: >
      docker compose --env-file <policy-env-without-DEV_WORKER_REPLICAS> -f docker/docker-compose.infra.yml
      --profile runtime config
